action_items: None for this delta. Resend key rotation from iteration 19 is still the only outstanding item (already reported and out of scope for this iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: api/index.js correctly guards the /careers/<slug> share dispatch with `!rawPath.replace(/^\/+/, '').startsWith('api')` so /api/careers?slug=… still returns JSON — verified by TestDispatcherRouting.
careers-share.js has a solid never-break-page fallback: if origin/index.html fetch fails, it 302s to /careers instead of returning a broken shell.

careers-share.js JobPosting JSON-LD uses `employmentType: String(job.employment_type || 'Full-Time').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]+/g, '_')` — this turns 'Founder / Director' into 'FOUNDER_DIRECTOR' and 'Full-Time' into 'FULL_TIME' which schema.org accepts loosely but note Google's spec expects one of FULL_TIME/PART_TIME/CONTRACTOR/TEMPORARY/INTERN/VOLUNTEER/PER_DIEM/OTHER — non-critical, cosmetic for the JSON-LD.

careers-admin.js buildJobDoc caps department at 140 chars (matches the request), preserves layer, and defaults hiring_stage to 'Open Role'. Duplicate-slug guard still uses `{ slug, id: { $ne: existing.id } }` correctly.
careers-apply.js correctly returns 409 (not 400) for stages in ['Role Closed','On Hold'] AFTER the payload validation but BEFORE assembling chunks — cheap and correct ordering.
vercel.json rewrite order verified programmatically: /api/(.*) then /careers/:slug then the index.html catch-all — correct precedence.

JobEditor uses a synthetic value '__custom__' for the 'Other — type my own…' option and detects custom mode via `!DEPARTMENTS.includes(form.department) || form._customDept` — this correctly re-opens custom mode when loading an existing role whose department is not in the canonical list.
JobPopup.accepting = `!STAGES_NOT_ACCEPTING.includes(job.hiring_stage)` is a clean single source of truth for both the disabled state and the footer copy.
